prereg.version: bench (research plan v4, stage S1 preregistration)
prereg.dash_note: S1 hits 0/16 at 0.25 m; 12th-largest travel 0.152 m -> target 0.15 m
prereg.supervisor: goal signal per task (nod: until |pitch| >= 30 deg held 0.1 s; dash: until DASH_M reached), truth-based, same for all arms
prereg.learned_policy: DescendingNet: 18 raw-IMU features + 2 command channels -> hidden LIF (delay banks) -> 2 spiking motor outputs + 1 graded pitch reference; trained by imitation of the opponents (descend.py train) then fine-tuned by policy search on fresh training cases (descend.py finetune)

hypotheses.H1: composite <= 0.95 in >= 2 of 3 fine-tuned seeds AND T1 ratio <= 1.05 in those seeds (learned beats the classical opponents overall without losing hover)
hypotheses.H2: >= 2 of the maneuver tasks (T2, T3, T4) have ratio <= 0.90 in >= 2 of 3 seeds (the advantage comes from the maneuvers)
hypotheses.H3: mechanism: clamping gyro+accelerometer inputs raises the composite by >= 10 % or silences the pulses; zeroing all delays raises it by >= 10 %
hypotheses.H4: an ANN/rate control of the same size is expected to match (no SNN performance claim); pending
hypotheses.hybrid: if H1 fails but some task ratio <= 0.9, the best hybrid (per-task best of classical/learned) is reported as the result

gate_S0.dash: S1 hits 0/16 at 0.25 m; 12th-largest travel 0.152 m -> target 0.15 m
